title: Merchandise Returns Policy of Northgate Store and Online Orders
content:
**§1 Status.** Under **Northgate Store and Online Orders**, a return is accepted only on an order in fulfilled status, as the system record of that order shows.

**§2 Window.** Each item's return window is the program's return window for the line's return class. Items of the non-returnable class cannot be returned, only refunded under the fulfilment and cancellation rule when missing or damaged on arrival.

**§3 Time gate.** A return with a receipt is accepted only when the return date is no later than the fulfilled date plus the item's return window days. The clock starts from the order's fulfilled date in the system record, and the return class is that of the order line returned. Calendar days are added to the fulfilled date, the day after it being day 1, after first extending the window by the extra days of the cardholder benefits of Northgate Card Credit Accounts (issued by Harbor Point Bank, N.A.) when the line was paid with a Northgate Card and, for a line of a holiday-rule class ordered inside the holiday purchase period, counting from the holiday return start of that year instead whenever that date is later than the fulfilled date; a return on the last day still qualifies.

| Hypothetical case (general merchandise, 90 days, no card extension, fulfilled 3 March) | Return date | Accepted with a receipt |
|---|---|---|
| last day of the window | 1 June | yes |
| the day after | 2 June | no |

**§4 Units.** The units returned on a line can never exceed the units bought less the units already returned or refunded on that line.

**§5 Refund.** The clause *"The merchandise refund is the line's net amount per unit times the units returned, rounded half up to the cent, less the program's changed-mind restocking percentage where the reason is changed mind and the class is one of the program's restocking classes."* is **no longer in force**; it is superseded by the current basis for merchandise refunds.

**§6 Fulfilment fee.** The order's fulfilment fee is refunded with reason fee refund only when the return reason is one of the program's fee refund reasons.

**§7 Tender and channel.** A refund with a receipt is paid under the program's refund tender rule; a gift-receipt or no-receipt return under the rule for returns without a receipt. Returns are made through the program's return methods, the window anchor is the program's anchor, a mail return label costs the program's label fee, and proof of purchase may be any of the program's accepted proofs.

**§8 After the window.** A defect found after the window is routed under the program's route for defects outside the window.

**§9 Linked records.** A returned unit's Northgate Protect plan is canceled with a full refund under the plan cancellation refund of Northgate Protect Protection Plans (administered by Keystone Protection Services), and Northgate Cash earned on it is reversed under the Northgate Cash reversal rule of Northgate Rewards and Northgate+ Memberships.

superseded_clauses: The merchandise refund is the line's net amount per unit times the units returned, rounded half up to the cent, less restocking_fee_pct_changed_mind percent where the reason is changed_mind and the class is in restocking_fee_classes.
